name: @aliran/react-native
description: Aliran React Native binding — Bare worklet host + drop-in <AliranVideo> on react-native-video
comment: Ships TypeScript source — Metro consumes it directly (RN CLI's default sourceExts include ts/tsx). Its own native piece: android/ is a small Kotlin library RN CLI autolinking picks up from this package with no manual registration, carrying two modules behind ONE ReactPackage (autolinking infers a single one per library — add there, never a second class) — NativeModules.AliranUpdate, the OTA APK installer, and NativeModules.AliranSecureKey, the Android Keystore wrap/unwrap behind the TV sign-in vault; everything else stays JS (react-native-bare-kit provides the worklet runtime and react-native-video the player). The host app supplies the worklet bundle (bare-pack output; see client/backend). The react-native peer stays '*' on purpose: TV apps install it as an npm alias of react-native-tvos, whose prerelease versions fail any strict semver range (ERESOLVE) — with those, install with --legacy-peer-deps.
